derivation: Selected factual summary from retained sanitized historical reports and aggregate; no tests rerun or raw proof reconstruction.

generic_four_secure_gpu_workers.scope: Reduced tied-weight synthetic model conformance, not language utility; historical report-derived summary, not raw worker receipts.

limitations: Cross-platform PRV recomputation permits 1e-6 absolute or 1e-9 relative reporting roundoff; RDP retains 1e-9 absolute/relative checks. Original worker epsilons and all recomputed differences are retained. Analysis dependency versions are recorded; frozen accountant settings and exact mechanism-history checks are unchanged.
Worker provenance records four distinct EC2 instance IDs and fractional GPU profile UUIDs. These are retained deployment declarations, not remote attestation or proof of four physical GPUs.
Public-data research runs report per-node mathematical mechanism estimates; no full-history or group transcript guarantee.
Baseline and clipping-only controls are non-private; their epsilon is unavailable, never zero.
Sample SD is computed across three seed-level node/source means; nodes are not independent repetitions.
Cumulative budgets compose retained reservations, including failed/unfinished reserved horizons, at the frozen delta.
Exact consensus is available for final model exports only. Intermediate trajectories use CountSketch approximations.

Trajectory wall time starts at each node's first completed-round log. Reported node wall time covers formation, training and evaluation; it excludes preparation, final accounting and artifact collection. Fleet cost is recorded separately.
Calibration/final splits exclude exact image duplicates; distinct-person and near-duplicate separation is not established.

original_m3_secure_digit_execution.scope: Separate secure execution check; not a fourth repeat of the reproducible seeded utility curve; fractional GPU allocation does not prove four physical chips.

excluded: arbitrary callbacks or raw-data-reading custom optimizers
privacy_contract.unit: one example in a fixed local dataset, add/remove adjacency
